title: Bundle Suggestions
meta: Suggest items that go well together, with clear bundle offers and prices on product and cart pages. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Bundle suggestions that match items shoppers like
overview: Shoppers rarely see how your products fit together, so we show them. We set up bundle suggestions that say, for example, a starter kit or a complete set, based on pairs you choose and what your orders show. We build the bundles in your store with clear prices, correct stock handling and a simple label. We then place suggestions where they help, test the checkout and show you how to add new bundles yourself.

faq: Some stores use a bundle app, and others use built in discount tools. We choose with you based on cost and your platform. Any app fee is billed by the app maker, and we say so first.
Is this the same as Frequently Bought Together?
Related, but not the same. Here we build named bundles with their own price and offer. Frequently Bought Together shows pair suggestions based on real order patterns.
Yes. We test that bundle sales reduce the stock of each item, that sold out parts hide the bundle and that returns work. We check this before launch on sample orders.
Can a person guide the shopper too?
Yes. The assistant can suggest a bundle in conversation, using your catalog and rules, and offer the link. It does not invent prices or items that you have not set up.
